name: Retry cross-site chat messages
description: Sends chat messages that have not yet reached the other Joinery instance. A message whose first attempt failed — the far instance restarting, a network hiccup — is queued with a doubling backoff and retried here until it lands or is given up on. A refusal is never retried: that answer will not change. Reactions and deletes are best-effort and never queued.
